identity.title: [v0.92.1][shared-gate] Stabilize runtime_v2 unified kernel workspace coverage timeouts

values.summary: Stabilized the runtime_v2 unified-kernel workspace coverage gate by granting only the three timed-out fully qualified correlation/drift proofs a bounded ci-coverage nextest timeout override while preserving the default 120s ceiling for unrelated tests.
actual_changes: Added an exact ci-coverage nextest override for the three fully qualified runtime_v2 unified-kernel tests that timed out at 120s in hosted workspace coverage run 33017588921.
Set the override ceiling to 240s with terminate-after = 1, leaving the profile-wide ci-coverage timeout at 120s for all unrelated tests.
Corrected the override regex and focused proof selector to use fully qualified nextest names so the validation proves the exact override match surface.
Kept Runtime v2 product semantics and test assertions unchanged; the change is instrumentation-aware test/profile scheduling only.
Added issue-owned focused coverage and lifecycle evidence validators for #560.

actual_validation.purpose: Run the issue-owned validator using the same fully qualified exact nextest selector as the ci-coverage override for the three runtime_v2 unified-kernel correlation/drift tests under cargo llvm-cov nextest ci-coverage.
Verify issue-local lifecycle state and evidence directory exist before review/publication.
Reject whitespace and patch hygiene drift.
